●
●Grains: 5–6 oz/day - make half whole grains.
●
●Vegetables: 2–2½ cups/day.
●
●Fruits: 1½–2 cups/day.
●
●Dairy: 3 cups/day.
●
●Meat and beans: 5–5½ oz/day.
Physical Activity
The CDC recommends at least 60 minutes of moderately intense physical activity 
most days of the week for all children and adolescents. Aerobic activity should make 
up most of the 60 or more minutes of physical activity each day. Include muscle 
strengthening activities, such as gymnastics or push-ups, at least 3 days per week as 
part of the 60 or more minutes. Include bone strengthening activities, such as jumping
